name: Indrion Cart Milestones for WooCommerce
author: Indrion Tech

sections.description:
WooCommerce Indrion Cart Milestones for WooCommerce helps store owners increase average order value using powerful cart upsell psychology.

The plugin displays:
– Free shipping progress bar
– Discount milestone offers
– Real-time cart rewards
– Mini cart progress tracking
– Dynamic discount percentages

Customers are encouraged to add more items to unlock:
– Free shipping
– Percentage discounts
– Better cart rewards

The plugin works beautifully inside:
– Cart page
– Mini cart drawer
– AJAX cart updates

Features

  • Free shipping progress bar
  • Multiple discount milestones
  • Mini cart progress offers
  • Real-time AJAX updates
  • Automatic discount calculation
  • Mobile responsive design
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Lightweight performance
  • Customizable colors
  • Upsell-focused UI

Perfect For

  • Grocery stores
  • Fashion stores
  • Electronics stores
  • Cosmetic shops
  • Food delivery stores
  • Any WooCommerce business
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin ZIP
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
  4. Configure cart offer settings
  5. Set free shipping and discount targets
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support mini cart?

Yes. The progress bar and offers work inside the WooCommerce mini cart.

Does the discount update automatically?

Yes. Discounts update dynamically based on cart value.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes. The plugin works across all devices.
